Prevention: Consult your local extension agent for a listing of recommended varieties.
In the production field, rotate with non- solanaceous crops like corn or rice.
If possible, remove diseased plants or destroy them immediately after harvest.
Remove volunteer tomatoes and solanaceous weeds or vegetable crops that may harbour the fungus.
Avoid planting overlapping tomato crops in adjacent fields.
Monitoring: Monitoring and scouting at weekly interval to detect early presence of the disease as shown in the pic and described in the fact sheet.
Direct Control: At early growth stage, prune the disease leaves or remove the disease plants and destroy.
Restrictions: Spray fungicides when disease is first observed.
Fungicide applied at early onset of disease symptoms in susceptible varieties will provide some control.
IV (U) (Unlikely to present acute health hazard)
